stories.author: @Salted_Neko
stories.text:
Around June 2021 I decided to get and play kingdom hearts since I was little and watched my older brother play kh1. When I got the hd remix of 1 and 2, I was hooked on the series, watching theory videos, reciting the weird lore to my friends, and even buying some merchandise. I soon after got Kh3 and its re:mind dlc, and I love the games for different reasons.
Kh1 for the slight nostalgic feeling it gave me the whole game
Kh2 for its combat, story, music, one of my favorite villains “XEMNAS”, and Roxas as a character(especially loved how he was in 358/2 days)
BBS just felt really fun to play.
And Kh3+re:mind for its flashiness, I ESPECIALLY love the vfx for the “Thundaza” spell, and the finishers for “Ultimate Form” and “Double form”. Also around that time, I had begun slow, but steady progress working on a video game I’ve thought of making since I was little. I was thinking about how combat would work, then I saw the interesting combos of KH2, and Kh3 and went “Yeah, that’s what I’ll base it off of!”. Now on another note, you may notice I didn’t mention KH re:coded or Chain of Memories. I frankly just didn’t care for re:coded, and I didn’t really have much fun with chain of memories. The whole card system while fighting a boss and freely moving felt so weird to me, and the thing I didn’t like the most was castle oblivion and the grinding I had to do in order to get past a certain door. That said, I know COM is a good game, but its combat and the late game grinding was just not for me, though i do like how it bridged the ending of kh1, to the start of kh2. Now when I’m with my mother, I sometimes play the kh2 rendition of dearly beloved because it’s so calming along with BBS's rendition, genuinely made me tear up from its beauty. This comment I just wrote within 10 minutes will likely be ignored, but I don’t care, I at least wanted to comment this to show my love for the series as a whole, even the weird bits. For those of you who may give this a like or even reply with something nice, thank you so much. This is the consumer of salt, signing off

stories.author: @juliuskresnik198
stories.text:
It's odd, to be filled with such Nostalgia so early in life. You hear so often as you grow up of how it'll feel, traces of experience, muddled with time and yet fondly remembered nonetheless. 

The melancholy, I didn't expect it tonight.

But, I have so much more life to live. I'm only 22. Recently diagnosed and medicated for a disorder I'd only heard about a year ago. Things make sense now, I feel in control like never before.

And yet, I look back here, this music thawing my disjointed memories and reminding me of the person I was. I see that kid, lost and scared, stumbling about in the dark on his own despite knowing deep down something was wrong. 

He didn't give up. It came close a few times, it really did but at every opportunity, he chose to be better. To be that stubborn little bastard he'd seen on TV and Video Games.

And now, I lay here at night, turning to the next chapter.

I'm learning to drive again, learning to relax, got a new job and I've even got a tentative plan for the future, even if it means starting over again. I'm still that kid but I wouldn't be where I am without the little guy who found peace in this Title Screen, in this game.

The past fills me with a soft sorrow and a warm peace in equal measure, and yet the future calls out to me, the future that little kid had always wanted. I'll take it in both hands and make him proud. I'll add to this collection of disjointed memories. I'll add the laughter, joy, love, excitement, pain, peace and perseverance of a lifetime as the man I've always wanted to be.

Dear Kingdom Hearts,

I'm writing to express my deepest gratitude for everything you've done for me. When I was a kid, I was bullied and felt like I didn't have any friends. But then I discovered your game, and everything changed.

Each of us attacks have good telegraphs and are simple to dodge if you have good timing, good rhythm, and you know the signs. And due to the way that his attacks come out, there are many ways to react to them, and therefore many more ways to counter them. As an example, I block the first attack at the beginning of the fight and then when he does the jumping slash instead of blocking it I roll to the side and then thrust forwards from the side to get him in a combo. stories.author: @SylumSolosEverything
stories.text:
The real name of this song is called "The Other Promise." There are TONS of different renditions of this song in the series and it's one of the most popular soundtracks in the franchise. This version is just one of them...

Correct me if I'm wrong,, but I believe this specific rendition only plays once in the whole franchise and that is in the beginning of Kingdom Hearts II during the cutscene when Roxas discovers the truth of his existence...that he is not actually his own person; that he is just a husk -- a remnant left behind after Sora temporarily became a Heartless in the first game -- and that the town he thought he grew up in was just a simulation -- a datascape which he was imprisoned into with fake memories and fake friends created for the purpose of being studied by someone he's never met. The most heart-wrenching part of this whole thing was the pure existential despair over the sudden realization that he was never a real person and that he was never even meant to exist to begin with. Not to forget that his friends weren't even real and their real-life counterparts have no idea who he even is. The existential dread of not only his existence being an accident and knowing that he isn't even his own individual but some scrap left behind by someone he doesn't know but the fact that the place that he loved and the people he cared dearly about weren't even real. What mattered dearly to him was in reality just someone else's disposable data.

I was like 11 or 12 or something when I played KHII for the first time... which was actually the very first Kingdom Hearts game I've ever played. It was a weird beginning to be introduced into the franchise, but I remember being just as confused and crushed as Roxas was when he discovered Sora in his sleeping pod. (The fact that Roxas was just as clueless to Sora's identity as I was only poured gas onto the fire.) I nearly wanted to just quit the game after that. The sudden turn in tone from that dark intro to Soras bright and positive adventurous attitude felt uncanny, especially considering that I knew ZERO background to the franchise back then.

stories.author: @korggg123
stories.text:
Unlike many who played KH1 before KH2, KH2 was my first KH game. So when I first started KH2, I didn't have any emotional connection to KH1's main character, Sora. Roxas was my first KH main character and thought that Roxas would be the main character for the rest of the game. I was an early teenager attending middle school back then, and to me Roxas was a cool looking character with spiky blonde hair with emo-like personality.

After hours of playing the game, I felt a strong bond with Roxas as well as his friends in the Twilight Town. But then, the story continued and I came to realize that all the hours spent progressing the story and developing relationships with friends were all fake and artificially generated. I have never felt so much disappointment and emptiness. All the effort and memories were in vain. 

And when Roxas encountered sleeping Sora followed by a sudden shift in the main character to Sora with 'bright, optimistic' soundtrack, I did not know what was going on. 
In my head, I was confused, asking countless questions... 
Who is this boy? Who's Sora? What happened to Roxas? I am still processing what is going on. Give me a break. I still care about Roxas and his pain. What was his purpose? What happened to his existence? Will I ever meet Roxas again? 
 
The sudden departure from my old friend and getting replaced with a new one was very odd and uncomfortable for me at that time. I was all confused as I could not catch up with the pacing of the story. At that time, I have never played KH1, so I did not have any emotional connection to Sora and his friends.  
(At least for people who played KH1 would be like "You are finally back! Good to see you! Btw, do you know where Roxas go?")
 
I was still thinking about Roxas's anger and despair, but without given any time to process that pain, it felt like I was being shove down my throat with optimistic soundtrack and a 'new adventure vibe'. And without given sufficient time to process emotion, I just had to play along with the storyline. 

Well... as story went on, I gradually forgot about Roxas and felt more connection with Sora. And when I finally encountered Roxas again towards the end of the story, it was like seeing my old friend, with whom I shared bittersweet memories, again after years. We both know we shared great memories but also know we both have changed so much that we can't go back to good old days (first meeting at the start of KH2). 

Anyway, it's this experience with Roxas that was most memorable in the franchise. The developers did a great job narrating the story. Instead of jumping right off to Sora, they found a clever way to introduce a new character and at the same time, make people like that character. 

"...looks like my summer vacation is...over..."
This quote along with Roxas theme in the background is what got me hooked into the franchise.

stories.text:
Sora: I don't get it. Why's everyone been calling me Roxas?

Riku: Because, Sora... Roxas is your Nobody.

Kairi: It was when you came to rescue me. Remember?

_[Flashback to Roxas vs Riku]_

_[Riku tosses Roxas' Oblivion right beside him.]_

_[Roxas, still conscious, picks up Oblivion and swings at Riku, missing his strike. Riku then follows up with a Dark Aura blast and Roxas destroys it with ease, missing his second attack.]_

Roxas: Why won't you quit?!

_[Riku catches on that Roxas is trying to impersonate Sora seeing as he is his Nobody.]_

Riku: Come on, Sora. I thought you were stronger than that.

Roxas: Huh? Get real. Look which one of us is winning.

_[Roxas notices that what he just said sounds exactly like something Sora would say.]_

Riku: So it's true. You really ARE his Nobody. Guess DiZ was right after all.

_[Roxas starts to get angry as he's heard enough about Sora.]_

Roxas: What are you talking about?! I am me. Nobody else!!!

_[Roxas charges at Riku with both Oathkeeper and Oblivion at the ready, missing his first attack but connecting with his secondary strike, staggering Riku.]_

Roxas: How many times do I hafta beat you?

Riku: All right. You've left me with no other choice.

Roxas: What?

Riku: I have to release the darkness in my heart... the dark power that I've been holding back.

_[Riku takes off his blindfold knowing if he has to win the battle at the cost of losing himself to the darkness, he would rather have that fate than perish at the hands of a Nobody.]_

Riku: Even... if it changes me forever.

_[Riku begins to turn to the darkness and changes to Ansem, the same look he had when Sora first faced against him.]_

_[Ansem's Guardian grabs Roxas and starts to strangle the life out of him.]_

Ansem: I have accepted it.

_[Roxas' last breath begins to fade as Ansem's Guardian rests him down. DiZ appears behind Ansem and he quickly puts up his hood.]_

Axel: Yeah... They did.

Roxas: I guess it's 'cause Xion copied my powers, and the Keyblade's powers, and they didn't need me anymore. And Axel, I guess you felt the same way.

Axel: You're wrong there! You'll always be... my best friend.

Roxas: Best friends are supposed to be honest with each other! Who am I, Axel? Xemnas says me and Xion are connected through Sora. I don't even know a Sora! Am I a puppet like Xion!?

Axel: You're different from Xion.

Roxas: Then why d-

Axel: Finding out the truth doesn't always work out for the best!

Roxas: What makes you so sure about that!? I have the right to know the truth! How did I even get here!? Why am I so special!? Where did I learn how to use the Keyblade!? I hardly know who I am! What is so wrong with wanting some answers!?!?!?

Axel: Roxas...

Roxas: I need to know Axel... Please... Who am I...?

Axel: You've just gotta trust me, Roxas.

Roxas: I don't. I can't. *turns away and starts leaving*


Axel: Roxas...

Roxas: Somebody knows where I came from. If I can't get answers here, I'll get them from somewhere else. That'll be the person... I trust...

Best argument I've ever listened to in a while.
